card.name: Single digits in ISBN and verse references
card.fires_on: A single digit right after the start of an ISBN (such as 0- or 978-0-) in a bibliography citation. It also fires on a verse number after a colon in a Bible reference.

modes.label: ISBN digit
modes.description: The first digit of the publisher part of an ISBN, right after the leading 0 or 978-0.

modes.label: Bible verse number
modes.description: A verse digit after the chapter and colon in a scripture citation.

card.plain: It marks a lone digit inside a book's ISBN number in a reference list, and sometimes a Bible verse number.
